name: Stage Manager
description: Push the pointer against the screen's left edge and that monitor's other workspaces slide in as small stacks of their windows, turned towards the middle; click one to go there, move away or press Escape to close. Nothing shows until the push

edge.description: The screen edge that opens the stage: left or right. With the bar on that edge the hot strip sits along the bar's inner side

dwell.description: How long the pointer must stay against the edge before the stage opens, in ms (100-1000), so passing by does nothing

maxWindows.description: Windows drawn per workspace stack, the most recently focused in front (1-4)

tilt.description: How far each stack turns towards the middle of the screen, in degrees (0-60); 0 draws the stacks flat
